question: Estimate the adoption of D2C beauty brands (Nykaa-marketplace's homegrown + standalone like Sugar, Plum, Mamaearth, Minimalist) in India by 2027.
idealClarificationQuestions: Customers buying directly from D2C brand sites or via Nykaa/Amazon? Both — total D2C brand consumer base.
Active buyer (purchased in past 6 months)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total female + male beauty-buying population → D2C share of category.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian online beauty buyers in 2026: ~80M (Nykaa MAU is ~40M; Amazon + Flipkart beauty is ~50M; overlap considered).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, buying D2C brands (not just legacy L'Oreal/HUL): ~35-40% = 30M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: By 2027 with continued D2C marketing dominance + launch fatigue (some legacy big-brand resurgence): D2C buyer base grows ~25% = ~37-40M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~38-42M Indians buy from D2C beauty brands by 2027.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~80M (Nykaa MAU is ~40M; Amazon + Flipkart beauty is ~50M; overlap considered).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, buying D2C brands (not just legacy L'Oreal/HUL)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~38-42M Indians buy from D2C beauty brands by 2027.

calculationFlow: Indian online beauty buyers in 2026: ~80M (Nykaa MAU is ~40M; Amazon + Flipkart beauty is ~50M; overlap considered).
Of these, buying D2C brands (not just legacy L'Oreal/HUL): ~35-40% = 30M.
By 2027 with continued D2C marketing dominance + launch fatigue (some legacy big-brand resurgence): D2C buyer base grows ~25% = ~37-40M.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~38-42M Indians buy from D2C beauty brands by 2027.
